title: Adjust 3D manipulation gizmo size according to FOV in the editor
body:
### Tested versions

- v4.6.2.stable.mono.official.71f334935

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated Intel(R) UHD Graphics 620 (Intel Corporation; 31.0.101.2130) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-8365U CPU @ 1.60GHz (8 threads) - 15.81 GiB memory

### Issue description

SOOOOO i found a awkward bug in Godot-4 that causes reality and tools to warp in it when `[Ctrl]+[-]` or `[Ctrl]+[+]` are held while a tool (rotate, movement, resize) are on with something equipped. For some reason, it warps up everything up and messes up everything in the editor. This is a video here to show it. It also happens in 3D worlds specifically. I am not sure if this is intended.

It is pretty much reproducible.

### Steps to reproduce

Steps to reproduce!:
1. Make a 3D scene with a MeshInstance3D or something 3D.
2. Equip any of the three tools here: Rotate, movement, or resize
3. Hold `[Ctrl]+[-]` or `[Ctrl]+[+]` ...
4. Viola! The bug has been reprpduced!

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cf7e44b9-b61d-421e-986b-235e3cc55391

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Pretty much there is no need to have a MRP here as you can always recreate it. It is not programming related.
